prompt: A lone woman in a vivid red coat walks along a long wooden pier disappearing into thick morning fog, with only the nearest posts and railings still visible around her. The calm water below reflects just a faint trace of colour before everything fades into mist. Soft pastel-and-charcoal watercolor style, hazy layered textures, restrained tones, strong depth and a quiet cinematic atmosphere.

translations.zh: 一名身穿鲜艳红大衣的孤独女子走在一条消失在浓厚晨雾中的长木码头上，身旁只有最近的立柱和栏杆隐约可见。下方平静的水面映照出微弱的色彩痕迹，随后一切隐入薄雾中。柔和的粉彩与木炭水彩画风格，朦胧的层次纹理，克制的色调，强烈的纵深感和宁静的电影质感氛围。
